context: Students react to a welfare-reform news segment
purpose: React to reform news; teach それでは/厚生/不明/答弁/援助/徹底/書き込み/陣/明治

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それでは、福祉のニュースだね。
lines.en: Okay, so it’s the welfare news.
lines.style: casual teen settling in to watch

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 厚生労働省が新しい制度を発表したよ。
lines.en: The welfare ministry announced a new system.
lines.style: informative student summarizing the headline, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 財源が不明なのが気になる。
lines.en: The unclear funding source bugs me.
lines.style: skeptical teen zeroing in on the gap

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大臣の答弁でもはっきりしなかった。
lines.en: Even the minister’s reply did not clarify it.
lines.style: critical student noting the evasiveness, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 低所得世帯への援助は増えるみたい。
lines.en: Aid to low-income households will apparently rise.
lines.style: attentive teen picking out a concrete point

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも徹底して見直すべきって声も多い。
lines.en: But many say it should be thoroughly reviewed.
lines.style: balanced student weighing the criticism, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: SNSの書き込み、賛否が割れてるね。
lines.en: The social-media posts are split for and against.
lines.style: plugged-in teen reading the public mood

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 取材陣も詳しく追ってたよ。
lines.en: The reporting team followed it closely too.
lines.style: observant student crediting the coverage, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 明治の頃とは社会の形が全然違うもんね。
lines.en: Society’s shape is totally different from the Meiji era.
lines.style: thoughtful teen reflecting on the change
